Definition: from G4253 and G5342; to bear forward, i.e. produce:--bring forth.
BiblicalUsage: Prophero means to bear forward, to bring forth, to produce. Jesus uses it once: a good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good, and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth that which is evil.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heart is a treasury, and what it brings forth tells the truth about what is stored there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
